title: Cute Tumbler!
text: Cute Tumbler!. I find that I am drinking more water these days because I'm using cute tumblers with straws like this one. This one is a pretty iridescent blue color. The lid screws on well. It keeps the water cool for a few hours, but not all day like a stainless steel tumbler would. I can always add more ice if needed.

product_metadata.title: West & Fifth Grid Plastic Cold-Cup Tumbler with Straw, Iridescent Semi-Transparent Square-Textured Cup, BPA-Free Double-Wall Cup for Iced Coffee, Cold Drinks, or Water, 24oz, Dk. Blue
features: WATER TUMBLER: Keep yourself hydrated with our 24-ounce reusable tumbler for cold liquids like water, iced coffee, smoothies, or tea. Each cute tumbler holds 3 cups of cold beverages and has a fun square-textured holographic design.

TRENDY TUMBLER: This unique textured tumbler has a wide mouth for easy cleaning and double-wall construction to keep your drink cold and refreshing for hours. The special rubber ring on the lid keeps it shut, and the straw base has a stopper that helps prevent your insulated tumbler from leaking.

HIGH-QUALITY MATTE TUMBLER: Each large tumbler cup has a reusable straw and a threaded screw-on lid to prevent spills and is made with durable plastic and safe food-grade materials. All of our tumbler bottles are 100% free from BPA, BPS, phthalates, and mercury.

EASY-CARE TRAVEL TUMBLER: This lightweight, modern tumbler helps you stand out, and it’s easy to carry to the gym, to the office, around your home, or as you run errands. To wash, simply remove the lid and straw and handwash it in the sink.

THE PERFECT GIFT: Gift this drink tumbler to anyone in your life who is on the go and wants to stand out from the crowd. Get this beverage tumbler for an iced-coffee or smoothie lover, or buy it for yourself as a brand-new drinking cup.
description: Need a way to keep your water or iced coffee cool throughout the day? West & Fifth introduces our handy reusable tumbler, the perfect cup for cold liquids that stands out from other tumblers. The outside features a unique holographic design and is decorated with square textures that can massage your hands as you hold it. This plastic tumbler holds 3 cups of your favorite beverage and maintains the temperature inside for hours to keep your drink cool and refreshing. The lid has a special rubber ring that keeps it twisted on tight while preventing any spill or leak accidents, and each straw has a stopper ring on the base that keeps it from falling out and adds extra leak protection. Made with sturdy plastic and safe food-grade materials, this sturdy tumbler can withstand daily use as you go from one activity to the next. It is lightweight enough to carry to the office, to your car, to the gym, or around your home, and it holds 24 oz. of liquid. Wrap up this grid-patterned tumbler to give to your loved ones as a fun way for them to stay hydrated while expressing their style. Find the cup you’ll love with our reusable tumbler options!All of our tumblers are 100% free from BPA, BPS, phthalates, and mercury for your safety and convenience. To wash your water and iced-coffee tumbler, remove the lid and the straw to clean the inside of the cup. Wash the cup by hand in a sink, and let it dry before the next use. This tumbler should not be used with hot liquids. Do not put this item in the dishwasher or in the microwave.At West & Fifth, we believe that there’s no such thing as a one-size-fits-all product. All of our products are exclusive, as they are designed in-house using fun, vibrant, fashion-forward, and custom colors and designs. Since inception, we’ve designed and launched over a thousand other quality products. We’re constantly bringing new products to market to fit with current seasons, colors, and trends that we’re sure you’ll love!
